findings.description: skills/scripts/check_skill_files.py main(): parser.add_argument('roots', nargs='*') is a remnant of the removed workflow. W37 relaxed it from workspace's nargs='+' only so the Verify Skills step could pass over a tree holding no skill (the test that observed that, test_a_tree_holding_no_skill_passes, is removed by W42). With no workflow it serves nothing, and it lets a run naming no skill pass: python3 skills/scripts/check_skill_files.py prints '0 files checked, 0 findings' and exits 0, so a by-hand verification or a script passing an empty skill list reads as a clean check where workspace's argparse refused it with exit 2. Fix: restore nargs='+' (the --compare form already names its roots).
